provenance.notes: Clean-room signup reply from traced parser code. Request POST /cgi-bin/dmBsignup.cgi built by ROM file 3B070C (POST template 3B45A0) with path dmBsignup.cgi (3ABD80) and host digi_b.wgg.channel.or.jp; 9-byte body semantics unknown. Reply status must be 2xx: file 3B0891/3B0898 accept '2' (3B08A5 checks 301/302+Location redirect, all else fails 0x1F3). Headers scanned line by line; Content-Length parsed case-insensitively (3B0A02) with decimal value at payload+16 (3B0B7D); blank line ends headers (3B09F5). Body first byte at DS:3814 decides phase 8 (file 3F8D45): 01/FF takes the non-registering path, any other byte copies body+1..8 to the account ID at DS:3A17, sets registered flag DS:3A0C=1 and writes the save (3F8D7D). Body byte 0 and ID bytes M32PLACE are newly authored placeholders, not recovered original account data.
